name: Assisted Pull-Up

instructions.description: Secure the assistance band to the bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grip the bar and begin from a controlled hanging position.
Pull the chest upward by driving the elbows down.
Lower slowly until the arms are comfortably extended.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Assisted Pull-Up — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Assisted Pull-Up — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Ensure the band and bar are securely set up.
